Pure Solution Purifier:
The process chip decides what this machine purifies:
· Acid / Base / Lipobond Agent / N-Methylol Base / Reducing Agent
· The N-Methylol Base chip keeps the stabilizing agent and only removes impurities
· Quality: purity cap 98%→100% (maxed at quality 50)
· Performance: nightly removal 10 mL→20 mL (20 mL at performance 50)
· Efficiency: lowers power draw (base 8)
· Chips are reusable; power and a matching chip are required
Insert into the Pure Solution Purifier to purify acid and remove the rest.
Insert into the Pure Solution Purifier to purify base and remove the rest.
Insert into the Pure Solution Purifier to purify lipobond agent and remove the rest.
Insert into the Pure Solution Purifier to purify N-methylol base while keeping the stabilizing agent.
Insert into the Pure Solution Purifier to purify reducing agent and remove the rest.
